name: Oral Biology PhD
summary: Research PhD in oral biology, with a separate UCLA graduate application selection.
detailsNote: Current 2027–28 central program admission requirements. Older handbook and undated funding statements are identified; confirm the written funding offer.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application
deadlines.note: Current 2027–28 central requirements; all materials by deadline. No closing time stated.

english.note: Central FAQ also specifies legacy sections W25/S24/R21/L17; confirm any program-specific thresholds. TOEFL iBT Home Edition and IELTS Online accepted; MyBest excluded; only most recent result considered. Scores within two years; previous Paper Edition or IELTS Indicator remain valid for two years. Exempt accredited US bachelor/higher or degree where English is sole instruction per WHED; satellite-campus non-English daily-life locations require scores. Citizenship/residence/work are not substitutes. Below TOEFL 100/5 or IELTS 7.5, admitted students take ESLPE and may need ESL courses. TA oral assessment has separate requirements.

applicationFee.note: US citizens/permanent residents $135; all others $155, nonrefundable. Central conditional routes include listed preparation-program participation with verification, need-based documentation, qualifying recent public benefits, and designated in-person recruitment events (2026–2027 application-fee program subject to change). Non-US/PR enrolled applicants need California state financial aid; nonenrolled income route requires qualifying US tax return. These are restricted routes, not an unrestricted overseas hardship waiver. International applicants must confirm eligibility with the program; GPB application page separately says it cannot offer international waivers.

documents: Signed and dated statement of purpose
Three recommendations, at least two from science faculty familiar with scholarly abilities; letters no more than one year old
requirements.note: BS, DDS, DMD or equivalent with strong basic sciences: two years chemistry (inorganic, organic, biological), one year biology and one year physics. Department recommends upper-division science GPA at least 3; dentistry background helpful, not required. Research experience and publications assessed. SOP describes background, work, research and career goals; CV includes education, awards, work/research, memberships/publications, volunteer work and hobbies. Apply to Oral Biology PhD; combined clinical degrees require separate clinical application.

funding.note: 2025–26 handbook: first-year support may be available subject to funds, then possible mentor-lab funding. No funding is guaranteed without an offer and signed contract; consider mentor resources when choosing labs.
